mapper.insert: INSERT INTO received_tx (file_code, base_date, account_no, amount) VALUES (#{fileCode}, #{baseDate}, #{accountNo}, #{amount})
mapper.update: MERGE INTO file_receive_log (file_code, base_date, row_count, received_at) KEY (file_code, base_date) VALUES (#{fileCode}, #{baseDate}, #{rowCount}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
